news_items.headline: Arm Holdings PLC Stock (ARM) Moved Up by 5.16% on May 22
news_items.summary: ARM gained 5.16% on May 22 as post-earnings bullish momentum continued; market cap exceeded $300B.

news_items.headline: Arm stock price forecast: $312 resistance as ARM jumps 16.16% to $298.23
news_items.summary: ARM surged 16.16% to $298.23 intraday on AI-fueled momentum; next technical resistance cited at $312.

news_items.headline: Arm Holdings (ARM) hits all-time high with 2030 forecast
news_items.summary: ARM hit a new all-time high alongside analyst forecasts that profits could rise fivefold by 2030 on AGI CPU adoption.

news_items.headline: ARM Stock Rallies As Wall Street Hikes AI-Fueled Targets
news_items.summary: Wall Street firms pushed ARM price targets into the $250-$300 range citing stronger data-center royalties and AI-driven CPU demand.

news_items.headline: ARM Stock Draws Wave Of Price Target Hikes On AI Hype
news_items.summary: Multiple sell-side firms raised ARM price targets following the May 6 earnings beat and AGI CPU demand disclosure.

news_items.headline: Why is Arm Holdings stock surging today?
news_items.summary: ARM rallied on Bernstein's Outperform initiation with a $300 PT, reinforcing the data-center AI thesis.

news_items.headline: ARM Holdings (ARM) Stock Surges 15% Following Cramer's Endorsement and Record Earnings
news_items.summary: Shares jumped ~15% after Jim Cramer endorsed the name on CNBC, citing record fiscal Q4 results and AGI CPU traction.

news_items.headline: Arm Holdings Stock Jumps on Powerful AI Catalyst
news_items.summary: Coverage cited Nvidia's Arm-based Vera CPU partnership — Nvidia targeting a $200B CPU TAM, with ARM collecting royalties on every Vera unit shipped.

news_items.headline: Bernstein initiates Arm Holdings at Outperform with $300 price target
news_items.summary: Bernstein began coverage of ARM at Outperform with a $300 price target, citing AGI CPU demand and royalty growth.

news_items.headline: FTC opens antitrust probe into Arm's licensing practices
news_items.summary: The U.S. FTC initiated an antitrust investigation into Arm Holdings' chip-IP licensing practices, creating a regulatory overhang on the business model.

news_items.headline: Arm AGI CPU demand exceeds $2B for FY27-FY28; supply gap flagged
news_items.summary: Arm reported AGI CPU customer demand above $2B for fiscal 2027-2028, more than double launch projections; supply chain initially sized for ~$1B leaves an unmet supply gap in wafers, memory, packaging and test capacity.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Bernstein initiated coverage at Outperform with $300 PT this week; multiple Wall Street firms hiked PTs into the $250-$300 range citing AI/data-center royalty growth. TipRanks shows Strong Buy (18 buys / 3 holds / 1 sell) with avg PT $253.35.

earnings_context.notes: Fiscal Q4 2026 reported May 6: revenue $1.49B (+20% YoY, record), net income $313M (+49% YoY), licensing +29% to $819M, data center royalty revenue more than doubled YoY. AGI CPU committed customer demand exceeded $2B across FY27-FY28 (double the $1B figure at launch six weeks earlier). Next print expected August 5, 2026.
